identity.title: PIT Wallet Profiles, Skill, Specialization, Archetypes and Cohorts
identity.objective: Implement one local/offline deterministic profiling layer over verified S10-WALLET-01 evidence: immutable content-addressed discovery cohorts, PIT market contexts and WalletProfileSnapshot outputs with honest independent-group sample strength, exact Jeffreys shrinkage, descriptive specialization, direct-evidence archetypes and PIT-safe public-account relationship clustering. No network, copyability, follower economics, qualification, strategy, paper, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-WALLET-02. The new wallet_intelligence/profile.py module, its additive package exports, one focused profile test module, canonical profile contract/status/spec artifacts and bounded wallet/status compatibility edits disappear. WALLET-01 contracts, ledger, reconciliation and public ingest remain byte-unchanged; no profile database, network state, dependency, workflow, credential, Hermes, paper, order, capital or live state exists to unwind.

api_matrix.reason: S10-WALLET-02 adds one deterministic local/offline wallet profiling Python surface and additive package exports. It does not add storage, networking, provider, strategy, qualification or execution APIs.

items.surface: wallet_intelligence.profile builders, records and strict mapping round-trip
items.before: WALLET-01 exposed immutable public wallet evidence but no canonical real-evidence profile/cohort/context records.
items.after: Content-addressed WalletDiscoveryCohortSnapshot, WalletProfileMarketContext and WalletProfileSnapshot records are built deterministically from verified local evidence with closed validation and no persistence/network side effects.
items.compatibility_requirement: WALLET-01 source, ledger schema and ingest remain unchanged; old WP79 fixture profile remains import-compatible but is non-canonical historical scaffolding.

items.before: Package exports only WALLET-01 contracts, reconciliation, ledger and ingest surfaces.
items.after: Profile/cohort/context records, builders, strict serializers and closed constants are additively exported.
items.compatibility_requirement: No existing export is removed or reinterpreted and no copyability/qualification/trading API is exposed.

semantic_fields.reason: PIT admissibility, cohort survivorship, reconciliation, independent grouping, shrinkage, specialization, archetype evidence, relationship clustering, content identity, serialization and non-authority are the complete critical semantic surface.

items.required_rule: The public profile builder accepts an explicit local wallet-ledger path and MUST call load_and_verify_wallet_evidence_ledger(); an arbitrary caller-constructed WalletLedgerSnapshot is not a canonical public input. The resulting exact ledger head hash is committed into every WalletProfileSnapshot.
items.validation_rule: A missing, foreign, tampered, or unverified ledger fails closed before any profile is emitted; the builder never mutates or initializes the WALLET-01 ledger.
items.safe_output: verified ledger head hash and closed profile error code

items.required_rule: WalletEventObservation evidence is admitted only through the shared evaluate_replay_admissibility contract using local_first_seen/public_available and retained DQ state. event_time is allowed only for historical action ordering/window placement and NEVER proves knowability.
items.validation_rule: An event before T0 whose first-seen/public-available evidence is after T0 cannot increase any profile sample or skill field; correction-after-cutoff and decisive timestamp uncertainty fail closed for use.

items.required_rule: WalletProfileMarketContext is immutable and content-addressed over its complete logical content except its own id: exact condition/token identity, instrument class, category/mechanism/horizon labels, independence_group_id, metadata observability/DQ/replay, optional binary resolution plus independent resolution observability/DQ/replay, provenance-manifest ids, policy/schema versions, and no-authority booleans.
items.validation_rule: Changing metadata, grouping, outcome, observability, provenance, replay/DQ, or authority semantics changes the context id; current metadata first observable after profile as_of is unusable for that snapshot.

items.required_rule: WalletDiscoveryCohortSnapshot freezes discovery_cutoff, evaluation_start/end, method, selection-policy id/version, sorted member identities/roles/reasons, exact discovery evidence/provenance and member observability, plus RETAIN_MEMBERS_IMMUTABLY. Every member discovery record must be ADMISSIBLE at discovery_cutoff.
items.validation_rule: A current/later leaderboard or discovery observation cannot manufacture an earlier cohort; inactive/dead members are never deleted from the immutable snapshot; evaluation_start is not earlier than discovery_cutoff and evaluation_end is later than evaluation_start.

items.required_rule: Profiles describe public-account clusters, never human identities. Only PIT-admissible PROTOCOL_DECLARED or ONCHAIN_CONFIRMED WalletAccountIdentityEvidence known by the cohort discovery_cutoff may transitively join subject wallets. SOURCE_REPORTED, STATISTICAL_SIMILARITY and UNKNOWN are evidence-only and never merge profiles.
items.validation_rule: Strong links discovered only after cohort T0 and all weak/source-reported/similarity links remain non-aggregating; all cluster wallets share one sample accounting surface so linked addresses cannot multiply effective sample size.
items.safe_output: content-addressed public-account subject cluster and relation evidence

items.required_rule: Before profile metrics, WALLET-01 reconciliation links are honored: strong same-event/chain-confirmation components deduplicate to one canonical event using identity-strength rank then record id; admissible supersession selects the successor; REORGED_OR_REMOVED and SOURCE_DISAGREEMENT are excluded from skill; unresolved weak similarity is never merged.
items.validation_rule: API/chain duplicate representations cannot double count and reorg/disagreement evidence cannot increase sample strength.
items.safe_output: canonical reconciled event set with explicit exclusion dispositions

items.required_rule: raw_trade_event_count is diagnostic only. Directional evidence first collapses repeated BUY activity to the earliest admissible episode per exact condition/token within an explicit market-context independence_group_id, then all correlated episodes sharing that group contribute at most one independent group result. Missing trustworthy group id yields UNKNOWN_INDEPENDENCE, never a raw-trade fallback.
items.validation_rule: Many repeated trades or related addresses in one event group cannot raise independent_event_group_count; missing grouping cannot create an effective sample count.
items.safe_output: raw count, eligible episode count, independent group count or UNKNOWN

items.required_rule: SampleStrengthEvidence reports group episode counts plus max_group_episode_share and HHI over those episode counts using deterministic Decimal arithmetic; skill itself remains equal-weight by independent group and is never size/PnL weighted.
items.validation_rule: One event with many repeated episodes is visible as concentration but still contributes at most one independent group trial.

items.required_rule: A directional skill episode requires a reconciled/PIT-admissible/DQ-clean TRADE_FILL BUY, exact standard-binary WalletProfileMarketContext, price in [0,1], exact condition/token match, explicit independence_group_id, binary resolved_token_value, resolution evidence ADMISSIBLE by profile as_of, action event_time inside the cohort evaluation window, and action event_time strictly before the decisive resolution-availability time. SELL and unsupported/unknown instruments are not directional-skill episodes.
items.validation_rule: Post-resolution trades, SELL exits, combo/unknown instruments, missing context, or non-admissible outcome evidence cannot enter directional skill.
items.safe_output: eligible directional episode or explicit exclusion reason

items.required_rule: For each independent group, arithmetic-mean signed entry residual is computed from one episode per condition/token as resolved_token_value - BUY entry_price. Positive group mean = success, negative = failure, zero = neutral. Jeffreys Beta parameters are alpha=successes+0.5, beta=failures+0.5; posterior_mean=alpha/(alpha+beta); posterior_variance=alpha*beta/((alpha+beta)^2*(alpha+beta+1)). Decimal precision is 50 and exported decimals are ROUND_HALF_EVEN quantized to 18 places then stripped canonically. No binary float participates.
items.validation_rule: A one-event lucky streak is visibly shrunken and low-N; no SKILLED/UNSKILLED/promoted state exists. The Beta summary is explicitly a regularized historical correctness summary, not a future success probability or significance claim.
items.safe_output: ESTIMATED_UNCALIBRATED or honest UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT state with exact decimals

items.required_rule: Per-group signed residuals and the equal-weight mean across independent groups are bounded descriptive diagnostics. Raw realized/unrealized PnL, trade size, leaderboard rank and rebates never become skill authority.
items.validation_rule: Large PnL, size, rebate or one extreme event cannot directly change the Jeffreys success/failure counts except through an otherwise eligible independent directional group.

items.required_rule: Specialization is descriptive only: independent event groups are distributed separately across category, mechanism and horizon dimensions from PIT-admissible market context. Each group contributes once per dimension; unanimous label => that label, multiple labels => MIXED, none => UNKNOWN. Counts, shares, HHI and unique dominant label/tie are reported with DESCRIPTIVE_UNCALIBRATED or UNKNOWN_INDEPENDENCE/UNKNOWN_CONTEXT. No SPECIALIST promotion state exists.
items.validation_rule: One category observation may describe 100% of one tiny sample but cannot emit a specialist claim or promotion; skill estimates remain separate per scope cell.
items.safe_output: descriptive specialization evidence without specialist authority

items.required_rule: Archetype is observed behavior composition, not skill or profitability. DIRECTIONAL requires an eligible directional episode; MARKET_MAKING requires MAKER_REBATE; ARBITRAGE_CONVERSION uses SPLIT/MERGE/CONVERSION/COMBO_COMPRESS/COMBO_WRAP/COMBO_UNWRAP; INCENTIVE_REBATE uses REWARD/TAKER_REBATE/REFERRAL_REWARD/YIELD; SETTLEMENT uses REDEEM_SETTLEMENT; TRANSFER_CAPITAL_FLOW uses TRANSFER_IN/TRANSFER_OUT/DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL. Unsupported events remain unclassified. One observed class => that class; multiple => MIXED; none => UNKNOWN. HEDGE is not inferred in v1.
items.validation_rule: A generic TRADE_FILL alone cannot force DIRECTIONAL or MARKET_MAKING, and no ML/LLM/intent inference is used.

items.required_rule: WalletProfileSnapshot id is SHA-256 over the complete canonical logical snapshot except its own id and MUST bind schema/profile-policy versions, canonical public-account subject cluster, cohort id, as_of, derived evidence window, exact WALLET-01 ledger head, all considered evidence decisions/event/observation ids, context ids, provenance ids, retained DQ/admissibility basis, related-address basis, all scope cells, sample/skill/specialization/archetype outputs and all no-authority booleans.
items.validation_rule: Any semantically material input, eligibility decision, scope/context/cohort binding, policy version or output mutation changes the profile id; same semantic inputs in different caller order produce identical bytes/id.

items.required_rule: Cohort/context/profile mappings use strict canonical JSON with sorted object keys, preserved tuple/list order where schema-defined, explicit nulls, no NaN/Infinity/binary float, strict unknown-key rejection and complete rebuild/revalidation on from_mapping. Every top-level record carries advisory_only, no_execution_authority, no_strategy_authority and no_qualification_authority exactly true. Profile schema has no lead-time, copyability, follower-PnL, expected-return, qualification, strategy, order, signing, sizing, paper, live, Gate-C or insider/deanonymization fields.
items.validation_rule: Round-trip reproduces the identical mapping/id; tampered id or semantic payload rejects; forbidden downstream-authority fields cannot be accepted or silently ignored.
items.safe_output: strict round-trip snapshot or closed no-echo error

member discovery must be PIT-admissible at T0, later evidence cannot back-create the cohort, and immutable membership including inactive members remains in identity
event_time before as_of with first-seen/public-available after as_of cannot increase any sample or skill field
API/chain duplicates and repeated buys in one condition/group cannot multiply independent sample count; supersession/reorg/disagreement semantics are honored
one successful independent group yields the exact Jeffreys alpha/beta/mean/variance decimals but never a SKILLED or promotion state
skill fields derive only from eligible independent directional groups and not raw PnL, size, leaderboard rank or rebate amount
category/mechanism/horizon distribution is deterministic and separate from skill; one group never emits a specialist or promotion claim
direct event mappings produce observed archetypes; plain trade fill does not force directional or market-making classification; multiple classes become MIXED
only T0-admissible PROTOCOL_DECLARED/ONCHAIN_CONFIRMED links join the public-account cluster; source-reported/statistical/unknown or later links never merge or multiply sample size
metadata/resolution first observable after profile as_of is excluded and an action after decisive resolution availability is not predictive evidence
non-OK DQ, unsupported replay fidelity, indeterminate observability and unsafe reconciliation remain explicit exclusions and do not increase skill sample
cohort/as_of/ledger-head/evidence/context/provenance/policy/relation/output mutations change profile id while equivalent caller ordering does not

cohort/context/profile strict mapping round-trips reproduce exact ids and reject tampered ids, unknown fields, binary floats and non-finite numbers without echo
missing trustworthy independence grouping produces UNKNOWN_INDEPENDENCE and never falls back to trade or condition count as n_eff
